command.name: inference-gateway-builder
command.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Implement only Phase A from docs/reverse-engineering/anyscale-local-team-inference-gateway.md. Build an independently authored, dependency-free inference-routing/v1 domain module and deterministic Node tests. Implement InferenceRequest, InferenceLane, RoutingPolicy, InferencePlan, InferenceGrant and InferenceReceipt validation/canonical digests. Keep privacy, residency, authorization, capability, quality, cost, latency and cache evidence separate. Unknown must remain unknown. Planning must not grant execution. Hosted fallback for private-code traffic must fail closed unless the exact policy explicitly permits it. Fallback cannot widen provider/residency/privacy scope. Do not copy donor code/configuration. Do not add network, model/runtime launch, provider calls, secrets, Git mutation, deployment, model downloads, browser work or real GPU work. Preserve existing behavior and run the narrowest focused tests before returning.'

repairCommand.name: inference-gateway-repair
repairCommand.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Read $SHIPPING_CONTEXT_FILE and $SHIPPING_FAILURE_FILE plus docs/reverse-engineering/anyscale-local-team-inference-gateway.md. Repair only the failing Phase A Local/Team Inference Gateway gate. Preserve plan-vs-grant separation, privacy/no-leak fallback, first-class unknown evidence and exact-digest binding. Do not broaden scope, use network, copy donor code, push, merge, deploy, call providers or execute model runtimes. Run the narrowest relevant tests.'

goldenPath.description: The same canonical request, lane evidence and policy produce the same deterministic inference-plan digest.
A client requiring Responses semantics rejects a chat-completions-only lane unless a separately declared compatible adapter exists.
Missing or stale lane health/capability evidence remains unknown or ineligible rather than being treated as healthy or supported.
Privacy/residency/provider constraints outrank cost, latency and cache-affinity preferences.
Private-code policy that forbids hosted providers stops after local/team failure instead of silently leaking to a hosted fallback.
A strict max-cost policy with unknown cost refuses or follows an explicit policy-defined unknown-cost rule; it never invents zero cost.
InferencePlan carries no execution authority; an exact request/plan/policy/lane-bound InferenceGrant is required.
Expired or mismatched grants fail closed and cannot be replayed for a different request, lane, policy or model revision.
Fallback can use only provider/residency/privacy scope already authorized by the original grant and policy digest.
InferenceReceipt distinguishes provider/runtime-reported token/cost values from local estimates and leaves unavailable measurements unknown.
Partial stream plus transport/restart failure records interrupted/partial or unknown outcome, never fabricated full success.
Successful inference cannot by itself upgrade an unverified model/lane to quality parity with another provider or model.
Raw repository/session source or secrets are excluded from canonical digests and are not persisted by the Phase A receipt model.
Changed policy, model revision, health evidence or capability evidence changes the corresponding canonical plan/grant identity where relevant.

excludedFromRelease: Anyscale donor source or configuration reuse
real cost or quality benchmark claims
Git mutation outside the isolated builder worktree
